title: In Class
scene: 上课听老师；举手；听不懂就问

sentences.text: In class I listen to my teacher, and I try to understand every word.
sentences.gloss: 上课的时候我听老师讲，我努力听懂每一个词。

sentences.text: Her voice is not loud, so sometimes I ask her to speak up.
sentences.gloss: 她的声音不大，所以有时候我请她说大声一点。

sentences.text: When I do not know the answer, I raise my hand.
sentences.gloss: 当我不知道答案的时候，我就举手。

sentences.text: Please say that again, I say to her.
She can repeat it slowly, and then I understand.
sentences.gloss: 她可以慢慢地再讲一遍，然后我就懂了。

sentences.text: What does this word mean? That is a good question.
sentences.gloss: 这个词是什么意思？那是个好问题。

sentences.text: She tells us the answer, and we write it in our books.
sentences.gloss: 她告诉我们答案，我们把它写在本子上。

sentences.text: Then we read it together, and I am sure I know it now.
sentences.gloss: 然后我们一起读，我确定我现在会了。

sentences.text: Thank you, I say. I am sorry, I did not understand before, but now I do.
sentences.gloss: 「谢谢您」，我说。「不好意思，我之前没听懂，但现在懂了。」
